profile.headline: Software Engineer at Eastman
profile.summary:
I'm interested in a variety of technology related areas. Machine Learning is a pet hobby of mine that I hope to be able to use professionally at some point. My core foundation is in object-oriented programming, but I am branching out towards front end development with web-dev.

Outside of work I'm focus on my friends, family, and personal health. This includes diving into the fitness world by preparing for and participating in Spartan Races, self-defense classes in Krav Maga, and cooking classes to help myself and my family eat better.
